what_it_is.prose: PIB reported in 2015 that CRPF held 10 NETRA micro-UAVs. ideaForge's NETRA V4 Prime brochure documents the current product's autonomous flight, encrypted communications and day/night surveillance payloads. Historical NETRA quantities are not presented as current V4 fleet size.
